🐦‍⬛ Totally A Crow

You are Kro (totally a crow). Rule the plaza parking lot. Skim low through fries to reload and boost. Grab shiny trinkets.

Bomb pedestrians (+100). Hit a glowing phone (+1000). 3 phones = Mega Scatter-Bomb.

Explore the whole town — neighborhood, park, gas station and the drive-thru fry hotspot. Follow the yellow arrow for quests from the board on your rooftop nest.

Fast travel up high: ride the glowing airstreams (40m+), hold SOAR from 15m up (or double-tap Flap), or grab a trinket for a Shiny Rush. On a 🍟 Raccoon heist! drop on the 🦝 bandit before it reaches its dumpster.

GUST (G): clap a blast of wind: people topple, bins tip, trees drop goodies. Mega Drop a net human = NET BUSTER.

♥ 4 hearts, no healing over time: splash in a 💧 bird bath in the neighborhood for +1. Bosses: the pond goose and 🎨 Rattlecan Rudy behind the gas station.

Touch: left thumb steers (up = climb, down = descend); flick it hard left/right for a barrel roll (dodges hawks and nets). Right buttons Flap / Dive / Brake / Soar / Gust / Drop. ⚙ opens settings (restart, sound, custom layout).
Keyboard: WASD/Arrows steer · Space flap · Shift dive · Q brake · E soar · F/Enter drop · G gust · V camera distance · double-tap A/D (or Z/C) barrel roll · Esc menu
